text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ministers tell the National Transitional Council that laws to shape proposed free trade zones are about to be finalised and a Qatari $100 million tourism project is under discussion.

- Spain's King Juan Carlos says at opening of the Spanish segment of the Euro-Maghreb gas pipeline that it a major achievement in terms of public works and infrastructure which will boost cooperation between member countries.
- The first trial of a "terrorist" Islamist network, involving 34 people, opens in France under tight security and in tense atmosphere.
- Recent Paris bomb blast gives new impetus to allegations that Germany has granted the right of abode to about 200 Algerian Islamist activists suspected of masterminding it.
- Algerian banks to reduce interest rates.
